item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.beh: PH: Dragging slows you down. Heavier animals slow you more.
PH: Where you hook matters: the limb you grab is the one that gets pulled.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.sum: PH: Kill an animal with this and it leaves a whole carcass instead of loot. Right-click a carcass to drag it, right-click again to let go.
